statement: kicked-ils (iterated 2-opt with double-bridge kicks, then Or-opt) gives shorter tours than 2-opt and 2-opt+Or-opt, the published baselines, at a budget of 1,000,000 move evaluations on 60-city Euclidean instances drawn after it was frozen: 2.2% shorter than 2-opt+Or-opt on average, on 11 of 12 instances.
status: Accepted on one beacon draw of 12 instances. Not yet compared with a mature solver.
scope: Example data. 60 integer points uniform in a 1000 x 1000 square, Euclidean distances, closed tours. The budget counts move evaluations, so results don't depend on the machine. Each row is exact and recomputable; that the gain holds on other draws of the same distribution is what the sign test over 12 instances supports, not more.

metric.name: mean gain over the strongest baseline

instances.note: Instance i of a draw is generated from SHA-256 of the round's randomness and i (tsp.instance). draws.json keeps each round's signature, so the randomness can be checked.
